mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a problem-solving process in which the problem solver engages in series of steps - taking at solving a particular identified educational problem."
Systems Approach is a problem-solving process in which the problem solver engages in series of steps - taking at solving a particular identified educational problem.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any form of studying undertaken through the use of any of the indirect media of imparting knowledge (Ojo, 1986)."
Distance Learning is any form of studying undertaken through the use of any of the indirect media of imparting knowledge (Ojo, 1986).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the content(s), subject matter or the topic(s) to be treated in a lesson or a term or during the course of study."
The task is the content(s), subject matter or the topic(s) to be treated in a lesson or a term or during the course of study.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a core prerequisite for teacher education."
Media production skill is a core prerequisite for teacher education.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a translucent, milky white coloured paper."
Tracing paper is a translucent, milky white coloured paper.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as instructional materials that are, by design, appeal to the sense of hearing."
Audio media can be defined as instructional materials that are, by design, appeal to the sense of hearing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for what is to be disseminated, how it should be done, where and how it should be assessed."
He/she is responsible for what is to be disseminated, how it should be done, where and how it should be assessed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an extension of a simple telephone call (Heinrich, Michael, James and Sharon, 2002)."
The audio teleconference is an extension of a simple telephone call (Heinrich, Michael, James and Sharon, 2002).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a universal and everyday occurrence, and therefore, it is a concept that has generated a lot of interest on the part of researchers, governments and organisations."
Communication is a universal and everyday occurrence, and therefore, it is a concept that has generated a lot of interest on the part of researchers, governments and organisations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the overall head of the centre."
The media specialist is the overall head of the centre.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a relatively permanent change in human behaviour arising from experience."
Learning is a relatively permanent change in human behaviour arising from experience.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the next stage and this leads to evaluation stage."
Implementation is the next stage and this leads to evaluation stage.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the receiver of the message."
The decoder is the receiver of the message.
